details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically build upon each other without contradictions. Revenue growth drivers are clearly explained in S1 and S6, cost increases are justified in S8 and S9, and financial metrics consistently show improvement across periods. The organization follows a logical flow from revenue to profit to cash flow and liquidity. While there is detailed discussion of offsetting factors (S7), these are presented as expected qualifications rather than contradictions. No material repetition or logical gaps are present. The summary forms a coherent narrative about improved financial performance despite cost pressures and accounting adjustments.
